title: Stationary iff mean curvature vanishes (Simon 2.5.5(2)) and second variation of stationary submanifolds (Simon 2.5.11, C³ correction)
statement: (5.5(2)) If M is an n-dimensional C² Simon submanifold of ℝ^{n+ℓ}, U is open and closure U ∩ M is compact, then M is stationary in U (IsStationaryIn) iff the mean curvature meanCurvature M y = 0 for all y ∈ M ∩ U. (5.11) If M is a C² Simon submanifold, U open with (closure M ∖ M) ∩ U = ∅, M stationary in U, and φ an admissible C³ deformation whose initial velocity X is normal to M along M, then t ↦ Hⁿ(φ_t(M ∩ K)) is differentiable near 0 and its derivative has derivative ∫_M (Σ_i|(D_{τ_i}X)^⊥|² − Σ_{i,j}(X·B(τ_i,τ_j))²) dHⁿ at 0.
